【turn523655893search0】 [wordlim: 200] Published: 2.5 years ago; Crawled: last month; The format of `LINKS`, as can seen above, is `source_path,target_path` where `source_path` is a path relative to the root of any namespace or package root in the wheel. `target_path` is a non-dangling path (i.e. a path that exists on the filesystem after the wheel’s contents are extracted) in a package or namespace of any package in the wheel. ... Installers MUST resolve the paths of any link contained in the `LINKS` file before deciding if any `source_path` or `target_path` are valid. ... Installers MUST reject cyclic symlinks in wheels. ... Next, check that the installer can make some kind of link for each pair in the site directory. If the installer cannot make a link for the file/folder `target_path` for the current platform, an error MUST be raised.
